items.body_raw: קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי לֹא־טוֹב אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי
items.answer_raw: Take away my life, for I am not better than my fathers.

items.body_raw: מַה־מָּתוֹק מִדְּבַשׁ וּמֶה עַז מֵאֲרִי
items.answer_raw: What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion?

items.body_raw: אֹהֵב יהוה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב
items.answer_raw: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling-places of Jacob.

items.body_raw: טוֹב יוֹם הַמָּוֶת מִיּוֹם הִוָּלְדוֹ
items.answer_raw: The day of death is better than the day of one's birth.

items.body_raw: וְאֵין אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמַעְלָה גָּבֹהַּ מִכָּל־הָעָם
items.answer_raw: There was no man of the Israelites goodlier than he: from his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

items.body_raw: הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים
items.answer_raw: O thou fairest among women!

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה שְׁמֹעַ מִזֶּבַח טוֹב לְהַקְשִׁיב מֵחֵלֶב אֵילִים
items.answer_raw: Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

items.body_raw: כַּאֲשֶׁר שִׁכְּלָה נָשִׁים חַרְבֶּךָ כֵּן־תִּשְׁכַּל מִנָּשִׁים אִמֶּךָ
items.answer_raw: As thy sword has bereaved women, so shall thy mother be the most bereaved of women.

items.body_raw: וְנִבְחַר מָוֶת מֵחַיִּים לְכֹל הַנִּשְׁאָרִים מִן־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת
items.answer_raw: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all that are left of this evil family.

items.body_raw: ועתה יהוה קח־נא את־נפשי ממני כי טוב מותי מחיי
items.answer_raw: And now, O Yahweh, take away my life, I pray thee, from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

items.body_raw: אעשה אותך לגוי־עצום ורב ממנו
items.answer_raw: I will make of thee a nation more powerful and numerous than it.

items.body_raw: And the serpent was more cunning than all the beasts (sing.) of the field which God had made.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי הַנָּחָשׁ עָרוּם מִכֹּל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים

items.body_raw: He has slain men more righteous than he.
items.answer_raw: הָרַג צַדִּיקִים מִמֶּנּוּ

items.body_raw: Thou art wiser than Daniel.
items.answer_raw: חָכָם אַתָּה מִדָּנִיֵּאל

items.body_raw: A living dog is better than a dead lion.
items.answer_raw: טוֹב הַכֶּלֶב הַחַי מִן־הָאַרְיֵה הַמֵּת

items.body_raw: And that man was greater than all the children of (the) East.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי הָאִישׁ הַהוּא גָּדוֹל מִכָּל־בְּנֵי קֶדֶם

items.body_raw: And he loved Joseph more than all his sons, for a son of old age (was) he to him.
items.answer_raw: וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת־יוֹסֵף מִכָּל־בָּנָיו כִּי־בֶן־זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ

items.body_raw: And he lifted up his eyes and saw his brother, the son of his mother, and he said, Is this your youngest brother, whom ye mentioned (said) to me?
items.answer_raw: וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־אָחִיו בֶּן־אִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲזֶה אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָי

items.body_raw: And he had two daughters, and the younger was fairer than the elder.
items.answer_raw: וְלוֹ שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת וַתְּהִי הַקְּטַנָּה יָפָה מִן־הַגְּדוֹלָה

items.body_raw: The greatest (men) of the city
items.answer_raw: גְּדוֹלֵי הָעִיר

items.body_raw: There was not left to him except the youngest of his sons.
items.answer_raw: לֹא נִשְׁאַר־לוֹ כִּי אִם קְטַן בָּנָיו

items.body_raw: And their gain was too much for dwelling together, and the land was not able to bear them.
items.answer_raw: וַיְהִי רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה הָאָרֶץ לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיו אֶת־שְׁנֵי בָנַי תָּמִית אִם־לֹא אֲבִיאֶנּוּ אֵלֶיךָ
items.answer_raw: And he said to his father, My two sons thou mayest slay, if I bring him not to thee.

items.body_raw: וַיִּקַּח מִנְחָה לְאָחִיו עִזִּים מָאתַיִם וְאֵילִים עֶשְׂרִים וּגְמַלִּים מֵינִיקוֹת וּבְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים
items.answer_raw: And he took a present for his brother—two hundred she-goats, and twenty rams, and thirty milch camels and their colts.

items.body_raw: וַיְהִי בְּאַחַת וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה לְחַיָּיו בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם לַחֹדֶשׁ יָבְשָׁה הָאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year of his life, in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

items.body_raw: בִּשְׁלֹשִׁים וָשֶׁבַע שָׁנָה בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁבְעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ נָשָׂא מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל אֶת־רֹאשׁ מֶלֶךְ יְהוּדָה מִבֵּית כֶּלֶא
items.answer_raw: In the thirty-seventh year, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh (day) of the month, the king of Babylon lifted up the head of the king of Judah out of the prison-house.

items.body_raw: וַיִּבְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִים בְּמַחֲנֵה הָאֹיֵב וַיִּשְׁאֲבוּ־מַיִם וַיָּבִאוּ אֵלָיו וְלֹא אָבָה לִשְׁתּוֹתָם
items.answer_raw: And the three mighty men broke through the enemy's host, and drew water, and brought it to him, but he refused to drink it.

items.body_raw: טוֹב יוֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ מֵאָלֶף
items.answer_raw: A day in thy courts is better than a thousand.

items.body_raw: וְרָדְפוּ מִכֶּם חֲמִשָּׁה מֵאָה וּמֵאָה מִכֶּם רְבָבָה יִרְדֹּפוּ
items.answer_raw: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand.

items.body_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם צְאוּ שְׁלָשְׁתְּכֶם וַיֵּצְאוּ שְׁלָשְׁתָּם
items.answer_raw: And he said to them, Come out, the three of you; and they came out, the three of them.

items.body_raw: ויחי אחרי־זאת מאה וארבעים שנה וירא את־בניו ואת־בני בניו ארבעה דרות
items.answer_raw: And after this he lived a hundred and forty years, and he saw his sons and his sons' sons—four generations.

items.body_raw: וימלך־שם שבע שנים וששה חדשים ושלשים ושלש שנה מלך בירושלם
items.answer_raw: And he reigned there seven years and six months, and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.

items.body_raw: His five brothers and three sisters went with him to the house of their father.
items.answer_raw: הָלְכוּ עִמּוֹ חֲמֵשֶׁת אֶחָיו וְשָׁלֹשׁ אַחְיוֹתָיו בֵּית אֲבִיהֶם

items.body_raw: The queen reigned sixty-four years and died aged eighty-two: she had four sons and five daughters; her husband died in the forty-second year of her life and the twenty-fourth of her reign.
items.answer_raw: שִׁשִּׁים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה מָלְכָה הַמַּלְכָּה וַתָּמָת בַּת־שְׁמֹנִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה וְלָהּ אַרְבָּעָה בָנִים וְחָמֵשׁ בָּנוֹת וְאִישָׁהּ מֵת בְּאַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה לְחַיֶּיהָ וּבִשְׁנַת עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבַּע שָׁנָה לְמָלְכָהּ

items.body_raw: And there were born unto him three sons and seven daughters, and his substance was six thousand sheep, and four thousand camels, and seven hundred asses.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּוָּלְדוּ לוֹ שְׁלֹשָׁה בָנִים וְשֶׁבַע בָּנוֹת וַיְהִי מִקְנֵהוּ שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים צֹאן וְאַרְבַּעַת אֲלָפִים גְּמַלִּים וּשְׁבַע מֵאוֹת חֲמוֹרִים

items.body_raw: The days of the years of my life have been four and seventy years.
items.answer_raw: יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיַּי אַרְבַּע שָׁנִים וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה

items.body_raw: There were a hundred and twenty-seven cities in his land, and in one of those cities there were a hundred and twenty thousand people.
items.answer_raw: בְּאַרְצוֹ הָיוּ מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וָשֶׁבַע עָרִים וּבְאַחַת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה שְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵה רִבּוֹת אָדָם

items.body_raw: The half is better than the whole.
items.answer_raw: טוֹב הַחֵצִי מִן־הַכֹּל

items.body_raw: And one said to the other, Let the two of us swear in the name of our God; so they sware, the two of them.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו נִשָּׁבְעָה שְׁנֵינוּ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם
